The Landcover Classifier Toolbox is an ArcGIS Pro toolbox designed for simple landcover classification using machine learning algorithms. It provides an end-to-end workflow for training classification models, generating predictions, analysing spectral separability, post-processing results, and symbolising layers for map creation.

Key Features

  • Multiple ML Algorithms: Supports Random Forest, XGBoost, and CatBoost classifiers

  • Class Balancing: Implements various oversampling techniques (SMOTE, Borderline SMOTE, ADASYN, SMOTE+Tomek, SMOTE+ENN)

  • Spectral Analysis: Jeffries-Matusita distance calculation for class separability assessment

  • Post-Processing: Majority filtering for smoothing classification results

  • Automated Mapping: Creates styled classification maps with custom legends and RGB colour schemes

System Requirements:

  • ArcGIS Pro 2.8 or later

  • Python 3.7+

  • Required Python libraries:

  1. pandas>=1.3.0

  2. scikit-learn>=1.0.0

  3. rasterio>=1.2.0

  4. geopandas>=0.10.0

  5. xgboost>=1.5.0

  6. catboost>=1.0.0

  7. imbalanced-learn>=0.9.0

  8. matplotlib>=3.5.0

  9. seaborn>=0.11.0

  10. scipy>=1.7.0

  11. tqdm>=4.62.0

  12. boruta_py>=0.3.0

  13. joblib>=1.1.0

  14. pyyaml>=6.0

  15. shapely>=1.8.0

  16. fiona>=1.8.0

  17. shap

  18. numpy>=1.21.0

Tools Included

  • Train Landcover Model - Train machine learning models using training samples

  • Predict Landcover - Apply trained models to generate classification maps

  • Spectral Separability Analysis - Assess class separability using Jeffries-Matusita distance

  • Apply Majority Filter - Smooth classification results using majority filtering

  • Create Classification Map - Generate styled maps with legends and RGB colours
